guarantee.heading: You approve <accent>before you pay the balance.</accent>
guarantee.body: 50% books your slot, and you only pay the rest once you've seen the finished site on a private preview and love it. Not what you wanted? Don't pay the balance. That simple.

delivery.q: How can you deliver in 72 hours?
delivery.a: A tight process, and one project at a time. A 10-minute brief gives me everything I need, there's no committee to wait on and no back-and-forth between three departments. You get agency quality without the agency overhead.

ownership.a: 100%. Domain, code and content are all yours after final payment.

revisions.q: What if I don't like it?
revisions.a: Every plan includes 2 revision rounds, and you approve the preview before paying the balance.

international.q: I'm not in the US. Does that matter?
international.a: Not at all. We work with clients in 4 countries, async-first, with same-day responses.

requirements.q: What do you need from me?
requirements.a: 10 minutes on a form. Logo and photos help, but we can work without them.

payments.a: 50% to lock your slot, 50% on approval. Card via Stripe, protected and simple.
